text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'aurora-ded-1' node-3 reported repeated GPU OOMs and auto-drain has begun. AlertID=INC-2026-03-15-RPL. Link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/INC-2026-03-15-RPL

oncall_sre_alex: Ack. I'm on-call. Paging eng-infra + eng-runtime + sec. @eng_infra_maya @eng_runtime_jon @sec_ops_luca

eng_infra_maya: Looking. Connecting to node-3 logs now. Seeing repeated kernel oops from nvidia driver: `nvidia: GPU memory allocation failed - requested 16384MB` then driver reset and OOM. Suspect HW mem instability or bad process leak.

eng_infra_maya: Sample log excerpt:
```
[Mar 15 13:22:11] nvidia0: GPU 3 mem_alloc failed: ENOMEM
[Mar 15 13:22:12] kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:01:00): 79, not supported by this driver
[Mar 15 13:22:12] kworker/3: kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 2389 (python) score 987 or sacrifice child
```

eng_runtime_jon: If node is draining it'll evict tenant containers. Quick mitigation plan:
1) Isolate aurora-corp pinned workloads and route them to aurora-ded-2 (warm pool)
2) Trigger immediate node replacement (prefer on-demand)
3) Temporarily increase retries at API layer for aurora-corp to avoid transient user-visible errors

customer_success_tess: @auroracorp_ops can you confirm observed customer impact? CS seeing a handful of error reports in support.

auroracorp_ops: We confirm: ~12 failing inferences out of ~600 during spike window (~2%). Retries usually succeed but SLA-sensitive jobs hit timeouts. Peak jobs running now (batch ingestion). Please expedite, this is customer-production traffic.

eng_infra_maya: Starting replacement now. Spawning new instance (prefer on-demand) and attaching to pool. Cloud command: 
```
# example (gcloud)
gcloud compute instances create aurora-ded-1-repl-3 --machine-type n1-highmem-16 --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-v100,count=1 --image redwood-dedicated-gpu-202602 --network aurora-vpc
```
If spot, we'll change to on-demand: `--preemptible` omitted.

eng_runtime_jon: I'm applying routing change for tenant. Command: `/redwood route set --tenant aurora-corp --target aurora-ded-2 --ttl 300 --reason \"node drain\"`

incident-bot: Remediation job started. replace_job_id=RPL-20260315-11. Estimated time to attach: ~12m.

sec_ops_luca: Quick scan on node-3 results: ECC error counters increased on GPU 3, no signs of compromise, appears hardware degradation. Will continue telemetry sampling.

oncall_sre_alex: Good. @eng_infra_maya please escalate to hardware team if replacement fails. I'll stay on thread and coordinate with CS/AM. @am_jeremy please standby for customer comms.

am_jeremy: On it. Drafting message to AuroraCorp operations and AM will be on call.

customer_success_tess: Created ticket CS-8742 and linked to alert. Notifying customer: \"We've routed your traffic to a warm pool and are replacing the impacted node. Expect reduced errors shortly.\"

auroracorp_ops: Understood. We'll pause new non-critical batch runs until you confirm stabilization.

eng_infra_maya: New instance booted and joined pool. Attaching GPUs and running healthchecks.

eng_infra_maya: Healthcheck output (short):
```
/health/model-shard -> 200 OK
/infra/gpu-status -> GPU0: OK, GPU1: OK, GPU2: OK, GPU3: OK
pool-status -> healthy (6/6 nodes ready)
```

eng_runtime_jon: Rolling traffic back to aurora-ded-2 -> aurora-ded-1 replacement after validation. Reverting temporary route. Running gradual traffic shift (10% -> 50% -> 100%) over 5 minutes.

incident-bot: Replace job RPL-20260315-11 completed. Duration so far: 00:12:40.

eng_runtime_jon: Error rate for aurora-corp dropped back to baseline. Latency normalized. Monitoring for 30m.

sec_ops_luca: ECC counters stopped increasing on the new node. Old node reports persistent ECC/driver errors — mark for RMA.

oncall_sre_alex: Good work. We'll mark the old instance for hardware RMA and block it from future scheduling. Runbook ref: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-pool-node-failure

customer_success_tess: Customer notified of resolution and next steps (RMA & postmortem). They requested a follow-up call tomorrow.

auroracorp_ops: Thanks team — impact reduced, appreciate the fast reroute. We'll coordinate with AM for the postmortem.

oncall_sre_alex: Closing incident and handing off for postmortem write-up. I'll keep monitoring for the remainder of the shift. Tagging for follow-up: eng-infra, eng-runtime, security, cs.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: RPL-20260315-11 status=resolved. Start=1867512345 End=1867515845 Duration=00:58:00.

customer_success_tess: Adding notes to CS-8742: impact ~2% failed inferences, mitigated via failover to aurora-ded-2 and node replacement. Postmortem meeting scheduled. :white_check_mark:
